name: talentlens-ai
description: TalentLens AI — Fortis hackathon demo for internal talent matching

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.setup-db: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev --name init && npx prisma db seed
